name: Park Seo-Yeon
bio:
Park Seo-Yeon's meticulous approach to race strategy stems from her early fascination with complex systems. Originally studying engineering, she found herself drawn to the dynamic, high-stakes environment of motorsport after attending a local touring car race. She began her career as a data analyst for a smaller team, quickly demonstrating an aptitude for identifying critical performance bottlenecks and optimizing race day decisions. 

At PEX Motorsport, Seo-Yeon is known for her rigorous pre-race simulations and her ability to adapt quickly to changing track conditions. While some find her methods exacting, even demanding, her focus on detail and her unwavering commitment to achieving the optimal outcome have consistently delivered results. She firmly believes that thorough preparation is the key to mitigating risk and maximizing opportunities on race day, a philosophy she instills in her team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight hair with subtle layers, often pulled back into a low ponytail.
physical.description: Seo-Yeon has a serious demeanor, accentuated by her sharp features and intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with handwritten notes and calculations.
Insists on drinking a specific brand of green tea before every race.
Repeatedly adjusts her headset, even when it's already perfectly positioned.
